quizzes.lessonTitle: Final knowledge check: mixed practice across all modules
quizzes.title: CARSI Building Science Foundations — Final Knowledge Check

questions.questionText: Air in a room warms from 18 °C to 26 °C with no water added or removed. What happens?
options: RH falls, g/kg stays the same
RH rises, g/kg stays the same
RH falls, g/kg falls as well
RH stays, g/kg rises a little

questions.questionText: What is the dew point of air at 25 °C and 60% RH?
Using W = 622 × p<sub>w</sub> / (p − p<sub>w</sub>) with p<sub>w</sub> = 1.902 kPa at 101.325 kPa, what is W?
Which number should you use to track drying progress from day to day?
A wet surface is at 22 °C (p<sub>ws</sub> 2.645 kPa) and the room air is 22 °C, 45% RH. What is the vapour pressure differential?
A skirting offcut weighs 152.4 g wet and 120.0 g oven-dry. What is its moisture content?
Where should the dry standard for wet skirting come from?
options: A fixed percentage for every job
The meter maker’s printed default value
Unaffected skirting in the same building
Any dry material in the room

questions.questionText: Using the Wood Handbook EMC equation, about what EMC does timber reach at 20 °C and 55% RH?
Indoors 20 °C, outdoors 3 °C, U = 6.9 W/m²·K, R<sub>si</sub> = 0.13 m²·K/W. What is the inside surface temperature?
A surface is at 13.4 °C and the room dew point is 14.4 °C. What do you expect?
A wet ceiling patch reads 18 °C in a room with a 12.6 °C dew point. What is most likely?
A 54 m³ room has an air filtration device moving 500 m³/h. What is the ACH?
Outdoor CO<sub>2</sub> is 420 ppm; room CO<sub>2</sub> falls from 1400 to 553 ppm in one hour. What is the ACH?
Inside is 9.06 g/kg and outside is 12.78 g/kg. Should you ventilate with outside air?
How many climate zones does the NCC use for its energy efficiency provisions?
According to the ABCB handbook, what do NCC climate zones indicate about condensation risk?
Which BoM statistics does the ABCB handbook say indicate atmospheric water vapour content?
options: Mean daily rainfall totals for each month
Highest recorded wind gusts in each year
Mean daily sunshine hours for each season

questions.questionText: Dehumidifier inlet is 11.20 g/kg and outlet is 6.13 g/kg. What is the grain depression?
What does CARSI do with the content of a paid standard such as AS 1668.2:2024?
options: Quote its key ventilation rates directly
Summarise its main requirements for learners
Name it and check the edition
Paste short tables with an attribution

questions.questionText: Visible mould is on a wet wall. What happens to air movers aimed at it?
